args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight shirts and shorts
- Light jacket or sweater
- Swimwear
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Beach sandals
- Towels
- Quick-dry swimwear
- Extra socks and underwear

### Toiletries
- Sunscreen
- Insect repellent
- Toiletries (toothbrush, toothpaste, etc.)
- Travel-sized shampoo and conditioner
- Hair ties or clips
- Beach towel

### Electronics
- Smartphone with charger
- Travel adapter
- Portable power bank

### Miscellaneous
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, etc.)
- Travel insurance documents
- Cash and credit cards
- Travel journal or notebook
- Camera or smartphone for photos
- Snorkel and mask if planning to snorkel
- Beach umbrella or parasol
- Sun hat or wide-brimmed hat
